plan.series_summary: Rentaro Aijo encounters his destined third soulmate, the painfully shy and mute bookworm Shizuka Yoshimoto, in the school library. To bridge the silence that has isolated her from the world, Rentaro immerses himself in her favorite romance novel, passionately reenacting its climax to win her trust, and manually transcribes the entire book into a digital text-to-speech app so her beloved characters can give voice to her deepest thoughts. Confronting his existing girlfriends Hakari and Karane on the school rooftop, Rentaro and Shizuka bravely face their scrutiny, ultimately winning their hearts and uniting all three soulmates in a heartwarming bond of mutual devotion.

parts.title: Destiny Struck In A Silent Library

segments.voiceover_text: Rentaro believed surviving two simultaneous soulmates was already impossible, but destiny was far from finished with him.
Reaching for an out-of-reach book in the quiet school library, his fingers brush against a tiny classmate. Their eyes lock, and an electric shock of soulmate lightning violently jolts them both.
Panicking, she hides behind a worn romance novel. When Rentaro gently speaks to her, she refuses to utter a sound, instead pointing her trembling finger at printed sentences on the page.
Her student card reveals her name is Shizuka Yoshimoto, a girl trapped in complete silence. What painful secret stole her voice?

parts.title: He Read Her Secret All Night

segments.voiceover_text: Determined to understand her silent world, Rentaro borrows Shizuka's beloved novel, refusing to sleep as he devours every single emotional chapter before sunrise.
The very next morning, he surprises her by passionately reenacting the fantasy story's dramatic climax aloud right in the middle of the quiet library aisle. Shizuka stares in stunned disbelief.
Pouring unhinged theatricality into every tragic line, Rentaro boldly shouts the characters' eternal devotion until nearby library patrons turn around to gawk in utter shock.
Seeing someone truly honor her private sanctuary, Shizuka beams through overwhelming tears. But can printed pages truly keep her connected to the real world?

parts.title: A Silent Heart Pushed To The Brink

segments.voiceover_text: Sitting together in the sunny courtyard, Shizuka nervously guides Rentaro's gaze across printed passages confessing the painful origins of her silence.
Cruel classmates once mocked her quiet voice, leaving her terrified of speaking aloud until romance books became her only dependable sanctuary from rejection.
Rentaro warmly thanks her for trusting him, swearing with fierce sincerity that she never needs to force her spoken voice just to please others.

Suddenly, a careless stumble nearly sends her precious novel tumbling straight toward a water fountain, while Hakari and Karane spot Rentaro's disappearance. Can he hide this encounter before jealousy explodes?

parts.title: The Impossible Miracle In Her Hands

segments.voiceover_text: Dodging his girlfriends' suspicious questions, Rentaro slips away in secrecy to execute an exhausting, heartfelt plan for Shizuka's sake.
Meeting her alone between the library stacks, he asks to borrow her smartphone, leaving the shy bookworm bewildered by his unexpected request.
He reveals an astonishing surprise: he stayed awake through the night manually typing her entire novel into a speech engine so her beloved book can speak directly for her.
Shizuka taps the screen, hearing her feelings spoken aloud for the first time, and weeps in gratitude. But what happens when Rentaro introduces her to his other lovers?

parts.title: Three Hearts Bound Against All Odds

segments.voiceover_text: Up on the windy school rooftop, Hakari and Karane fiercely corner Rentaro, demanding to know where his attention has wandered all afternoon.
Bracing for furious accusations, Rentaro drops toward his knees, shielding the tiny, trembling Shizuka safely behind his back.
Gathering her courage, Shizuka presses her smartphone screen, letting the digital voice softly ask if they could please become friends.
Disarmed by her helpless innocence, both girls shriek with adoration, aggressively smothering Shizuka in an affectionate embrace of pure love.
With three soulmates united under the open sky, Rentaro passionately vows to protect every single one of their radiant smiles for eternity.
